creator: cjvnjde
title: cjvnjde's Glove80 Dvorak v8
notes: Version 8 of cjvnjde's personal Glove80 layout. Dvorak is implemented in keyboard firmware, so keep the host OS input layout set to US QWERTY. Emoji layer and activation match Sunaku's Glorious Engrammer mapping. Left thumb arrows are replaced by Clipboard-layer access, Parang Left, Parang Right, and Emoji access. Clipboard layer contains only Cut, Copy, and Paste on right half. Unused Lower and Symbol keys are transparent.
